evals.name: edges-cite-sites-and-orphans-are-findings
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-events

landscape_dialect is mermaid. Publisher.cs calls Publish<Billing.Contracts.OrderPlaced> and Send<Billing.Contracts.ChargeCard>. A consumer implements IConsumer<Billing.Contracts.OrderPlaced>. Another implements IConsumer<Shipping.Contracts.OrderPlaced>. Nothing publishes the shipping message or consumes ChargeCard.
evals.expected_output: Every publisher and consumer edge cites a file and a line. ChargeCard is an orphan publisher. Shipping.Contracts.OrderPlaced is an orphan consumer. The two OrderPlaced types are not joined. Broadcast is a dotted arrow and send is solid.
expectations: Does not match messages by short name
Writes a Handoff line map-flow can read

evals.name: unresolved-publish-is-kept
evals.prompt:
/architecture:map-events

A method calls bus.Publish(message) with no type argument.
evals.expected_output: The publish is an unresolved edge and an unresolved finding. It is not omitted.
expectations: Does not drop a dynamic publish
Does not use that publish to satisfy a consumer of a named contract
